gates.definition: Minimum over21 body poses of sampled SAT separating-axis base-box gap; conservative bound, not exact mesh clearance.
Min over21 poses/all joints of nominal joint-limit slack minus.01 and torque-bias command joint-limit slack; not Cartesian distance.
Max FK(inverse(local))-local Euclidean residual over support path samples and feet.
Min over21 poses/4legs/3links of actual primitive-box separating-axis gap. The separate .010 path_leg_reserve is a ready-only preference, NOT this hard gate.
Min selected swing nominal joint slack minus.01 / gravity-loaded command slack and landing reload joint/effort slack; torque slack divided by30, not meters or native measured torque margin.
Max inverse/forward Euclidean residual over all feet and41 swing+5 probe samples; not only selected foot.
Min primitive-box gap over41+5 samples/all modeled links/legs.
Minimum estimated balanced vertical force across21 samples/all four planted feet, not native contact load.
Peak Euclidean norm of balance residual [sumF-weight,sum(dxF),sum(dyF)] after clipping/rescale over21 samples; raw N and N*m components, not normalized or pure N.

original_dtype_policy: float32 tensors / int64 leg indices / bool logical fields; Python scalar angle/clearance/reserve retain original double value. Native JSON dtype is not directly observed.
model_geometry_dependency: Must supply actual hip_origins/hip_lateral_offsets/link_lengths plus leg order and source asset/extraction provenance. Not present in original expanded input; no arbitrary reference model.
context_dependency: Use actual native box translation/quaternion and current9411 frame, original solver_frame/OBB/edge queries. No identity-frame mock or current new box scene.
acceptance: Exact original initial32768 bits,666ordered indices,11chunk bits/shape and original complete return; all9subgates from actual replay numeric outputs with identical joint conjunction. Human implementation/provenance review still required.
unknown_policy: Unknown dependencies, unbound dtype, changed seed/samples/precision or masked mismatch => NOT ACCEPTED; retain original native evidence unchanged.
signed_slack_policy: diagnostic float32 metric-threshold for >=, threshold-metric for <; zero is pass only for inclusive gate. Never replace raw original margin with normalized/scaled meters.
attribution_scope: Independent fail, exclusive fail, cumulative first exclusion and remaining counts over ORIGINAL666; order-dependent accounting is not physical causality.
